comparison.objective: Expose a buried pipe using a spade without touching it; candidate adjusts a robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Tool-mediated excavation with clearance control versus hex-key insertion, counterholding, collar tuning, locking, and dynamic-response iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Up to 80 mm of pipe exposed with zero spade contact versus two safe stops within stroke, rebound, overload, and drift limits. No separate spec versions were provided.
comparison.reason: Both require damage avoidance, but excavation clearance and damper calibration are meaningfully different.
